$comment: Blocks (docs/PLAN-MARKETING-REDESIGN.md section 6, M3). Each block has frames/blocks/<id>.ts (TypeScript, runs in a live frame, type-checked) and frames/blocks/angular/<id>.component.ts (Angular, compiled with ngc in strict template mode, MR-2). `components` lists the stylesheets the frame loads; `body` is the frame page markup the TypeScript fills.
